name: SHIMMERFIL (Ching Leung Inc)
summary: Amazon filament brand whose pending USPTO SHIMMERFIL mark (filed 2024-12-06, plastic filaments for 3D printing) is held by Ching Leung Inc of Cary, North Carolina, which describes itself as a 3D-printing materials maker with production in China and a North American branch. Sells high-speed and silk PLA, PETG, glow PLA and a lightweight foaming PLA at budget prices.

product_lines.name: PLA High Speed / High Speed Basic
Aero lightweight PLA
product_lines.notes: Foaming lightweight PLA per spoolfinder listing.

additional_notes: Store is Amazon US; no brand website found. Not related to Inland's 'Shimmer' PLA line (name coincidence). Ching Leung's self-description (production sites in Zhejiang and Jiangsu) comes from an event exhibitor directory and is unverified; the Amazon seller of record was not checked.

provenance.conflicts: Trademark record read on Justia 2026-11-06 (SHIMMERFIL, serial 98889053, filed 2024-12-06, Class 17 filament, owner Ching Leung Inc, #335 7151 O'Kelly Chapel Rd, Cary, NC 27519; the '#335' suggests a mailbox address). The US headquarters and China manufacturing come from a self-described exhibitor directory entry and are unverified.
